title: Give every contract or telemetry leaf directory a tests/ subdirectory

facts.note: Any existing or planned directory under the contracts/ or telemetry/ root.

A directory under either root that directly contains a .schema.json file is a leaf. The leaf definition is purely content-based, with no exemption by directory name; applies to every qualifying leaf, existing or planned, changed or not.

Any signal .json file, under either root (contracts/ or telemetry/), makes its directory a leaf. The source gives no mechanical classifier for 'signal'; its examples (metric.*.json, event.*.json) are non-exhaustive illustrations, not a naming or location restriction. A filename-based signal classifier would be a new observer.
When the planner acts is judged from the task; the rule itself is a tree-wide invariant and the validator checks every leaf regardless of phase.

fires: An existing contracts/ leaf with a .schema.json file has no tests/ subdirectory.
An existing leaf under contracts/ or telemetry/ with a signal .json file has no tests/ subdirectory.
A plan introduces a schema at contracts/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/ with no tests/ planned for that leaf.
A plan introduces a signal .json under telemetry/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/ (or under contracts/) with no tests/ planned for that leaf.
doesNotFire: A directory under contracts/ or telemetry/ that directly contains no .schema.json or signal .json files (e.g. only subdirectories).
Directories outside the contracts/ and telemetry/ roots.
A leaf that already contains a tests/ subdirectory.

given: A directory under contracts/ or telemetry/ ({domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/) directly holds .schema.json or signal .json files (any signal type, e.g. metric/event definitions) — a leaf, existing or planned.
when: The planner authors or reviews a plan, wagon, acceptance or doc that adds, moves or lists a schema or signal, or checks those trees.
then: Ensure that leaf directory contains a tests/ subdirectory holding the conformance tests for its schemas/signals.
prefer: Place tests at contracts/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/tests/ or telemetry/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/tests/, next to the artifact.
Include the tests/ directory in the same plan/wagon/acceptance that introduces the schema or signal.
avoid: A .schema.json or signal .json in a leaf without a tests/ subdirectory.
Collecting conformance tests in a central or parent directory instead of the leaf's own tests/.
An empty tests/ created only to pass the check.
why: The directory pattern is flexible, so each leaf with a schema or signal must ship its conformance tests alongside it for platform validation to verify the artifact against fixtures.
evidence: Validator test_contract_tests_subdirectory (src/atdd/planner/validators/test_contract_tests_subdirectory.py) passes: every leaf under contracts/ and telemetry/ has a tests/ subdirectory. This one validator covers both roots, so there is no separate telemetry validator to run.
Reviewer confirms the plan/acceptance lists a tests/ path under each new contract or telemetry leaf.
Compare against the source examples in verifier_detail[2] (positive leaves with tests/, negative leaf with a schema but no tests/).
verifier_detail: Leaf definition (content-based, no directory-name exemptions): a directory under contracts/ or telemetry/ containing .schema.json files or signal .json files (signal type not restricted). Required path: contracts/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/tests/ and telemetry/{domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/tests/ ({category} optional). tests_required: true.

Enforcement: src/atdd/planner/validators/test_contract_tests_subdirectory.py, test test_contract_tests_subdirectory; _ROOTS = ("contracts", "telemetry") so one validator covers both leaf rules — there is no separate telemetry validator to run.

Source examples (illustrative only) — positive: contracts/commons/ux/foundations/ with color.schema.json, spacing.schema.json, tests/color_schema_test.json, tests/spacing_schema_test.json; contracts/commons/ux/primitives/icons/ with icon.schema.json, tests/icon_schema_test.json; telemetry/ux/foundations/ with metric.ui.duration.json, event.ux.json, tests/metric_ui_duration_test.json; telemetry/ux/primitives/icons/ with event.ui.json, tests/event_ui_test.yaml. Negative: contracts/commons/ux/foundations/ with color.schema.json but no tests/ subdirectory.

Optional (non-gating) observers: a diff observer could flag newly introduced leaves earlier, a filename-based signal classifier could make 'signal .json' deterministic, and phase is LLM-judged; none restricts the rule, which applies to every qualifying leaf in the tree.
